detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: The article does not describe any specific malware or malicious code. It highlights the importance of detecting vulnerable open source components (such as outdated versions of Apache Struts) within application code, which traditional network scanning tools may miss. Detection strategies should include software composition analysis (SCA) to identify and alert on known-vulnerable library versions in application dependencies.
